provenance.interpretation: Valid means complete evidence, not a performance pass. Stage ratios do not replace lifetime budget accounting. Exec excludes launcher and meter entry proof.

acceptance_findings.interpretation: Grant distribution and coverage comparisons diagnose utility, not universal budget correctness. Exhausted pools may deny a hot rank. Per-case restoration is not required when work ends; assess separate recovery diagnostics. Emergency counts require available-funding, healthy-view and deadline context. No combined pass is inferred from these flags.
